summary: Two published notes: one ML-foundations course note on gradient descent and one reading note on the Transformer paper.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: One course note covers gradient descent: the update rule, a quadratic worked example, and learning-rate pitfalls.
areas.gap: Only one note so far; momentum, Adam, and other refined optimizers mentioned as anchors are not yet covered.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: A reading note on the 2017 Transformer: scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, and WMT 2014 results.
areas.gap: No notes yet on the flagged follow-ups: sparse attention, better positional schemes, or training-stability recipes.
